test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in 'Liberty' as per the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Trust and hope**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Preamble of the Indian Constitution** mentions "Liberty" as one of its core values.
 
• Under "Liberty," the Preamble specifically ensures freedom of **thought**, **expression**, **belief**, **faith**, and **worship**.
 
• The concept of "Liberty" in the Preamble emphasizes the importance of individual freedom and the ability to express oneself without interference, while respecting the rights of others.
 
• The terms "Trust" and "Hope" are not explicitly mentioned in the Preamble, as they do not form part of the constitutional guarantees or fundamental principles under "Liberty."
 
• The Preamble is a guiding framework for the Constitution, ensuring justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity for all citizens of India.
 
• "Trust" and "Hope" are more abstract ideas and are not directly tied to the constitutional rights ensured by the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Faith and Worship**__

 __
 
• **Faith** and **Worship** are explicitly mentioned in the Preamble under "Liberty."
 
• They represent the freedom to follow one's own religion, belief system, and practices without discrimination.
 
• This aligns with the fundamental right to freedom of religion under **Articles 25-28** of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Thought**__
 __
 
• **Thought** is explicitly mentioned in the Preamble as a part of "Liberty."
 
• It ensures the freedom to think independently and express one's ideas without fear or suppression.
 
• This is closely related to the freedom of speech and expression guaranteed under **Article 19(1)(a)** of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Expression**__
 
 
• **Expression** is another key component of "Liberty" mentioned in the Preamble.
 
• It ensures the right to freely express one's opinions through speech, writing, or any other medium.
 
• This is protected under **Article 19(1)(a)**, ensuring freedom of speech and expression as a fundamental right.
